svg.title: Taproot key path and script path
svg.desc: On the key path, the witness holds one 64-byte signature, signature_AB, for the output key Q. On the script path, the witness holds signature_A, backup script A, and a 65-byte control block made of a leaf version and parity byte, the internal key P, and the Merkle path, which is Leaf B hash. Bitcoin rebuilds the script tree root, checks that tweaking P with it gives Q, then runs backup script A. Backup script B stays hidden.

text.tspan: Key path: Alice and Bob sign together
Bitcoin checks: is the signature valid for the output key Q?
Script path: Alice uses backup script A
1. Hash backup script A, then combine it with Leaf B hash to rebuild the script tree root.
2. Tweak P with the script tree root. The result must equal the output key Q.
Backup script B stays hidden: only its hash appears.
